operations.title: Euler-domain Mellin Cauchy modes are total after Pick positivity
operations.statement: If the Xi Pick kernel is positive, its RKHS kernel vectors from the open domain Im(z)>1/2 are total: orthogonality forces an analytic function to vanish on an open set and hence identically. Thus the Euler-domain Weil isometry extends uniquely and onto the full Pick space; density and continuation are not independent gates after RH positivity.
operations.scope: Conditional totality and uniqueness theorem assuming Pick positivity/RH; physical relative-chain realization remains unavailable.
